subject: tr-def
title: (R)TR.DEF.-----RE.ST.
description: Diagram closing MP(II)-38, the section on geo-politics, alliance-formation, and the next composite cycle. The prose above the diagram names the structural object: 'the consideration of politics is not separate from what this involvement means in actual physical universe terms' — and 'the reality actualness of politics must be viewed as necessarily related to not only the state of given creative projections, but must include the future of the planet itself.' The crossing diagrams how the *transformation of working definitions* meets restructuralism at the planet-level: (R)TR-DEF (the reality of trans-definition) is crossed with RE-ST (restructuralism — actual form-rebuilding). TR-DEF sits on the left with the subject-arrow; SOC-RT-INT (social reality interpretation) drops from the main line and sits centrally as the bridging hub, with T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) and MT-INFO (multi-information) branching from it; POL-P (political policies) hangs from T-C-IMP and anchors the bottom-left, with INDIV-DY (individual dynamics) branching from POL-P, and POL-DYM (political dynamics) branches from MT-INFO to the right margin. RE-ST sits at upper-right as partner-axis; C-CONT (composite continuance) branches from the main line to the right, with WO-EXT-PRI branching from it and TRS (transition) from WO-EXT-PRI. SOC-RT-INT → MT-INFO on the central-right is the only edge that lets social-reality interpretation reach multi-information — but it produces multi-information *about* the situation rather than feeding back into TR-DEF's definitional work.
